extras: Desktop only; requires specific OS keys (Option/Alt); works entirely within Obsidian.
intentEvidence: Drag Bi-Link turns existing text in split Markdown editors into native Obsidian block links.
problem: Manually creating links between two separate blocks of text in different panes is cumbersome.
summary: A tool that converts existing text in split Markdown editors into native Obsidian block links by dragging or using hotkeys.
